parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift' in the 'Wallpaper' package, which sits under an Examples/SampleApp path and carries is_sample_app=false only by flag, but the path 'WallpaperSampleApp' unambiguously identifies it as a sample-app context. More decisively, the restraint rule requires no-action whenever any record resides under Examples/ or SampleApp/, which this file does. Lifting the production 'DisplayLinkSequence.AsyncIterator' type-alias from 'DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift' into shared code to consolidate with a sample-app copy would couple production semantics to demonstration code. The duplication is therefore intentional and load-bearing.
